title: Price bike-first, OV and occasional car use
intro: Transport is usually modest in Dutch cities until you add a car — compare subscription bikes, trains and car-sharing against ownership.

items.reason: Bike subscription with repairs — a predictable monthly mobility line for city commuting.
Train tickets and Flex-style subscriptions — model commute and weekend travel separately from local bike trips.
Car sharing for occasional trips — often cheaper than parking + insurance for low-mileage households.
